title: A self-maintaining, evolvable cell assembled from defined components

concept.text: The proposed innovation is a cell built from a characterized inventory of molecular components that can maintain its own essential machinery, grow and produce successive generations. With nutrients and energy supplied from outside, the compartment would copy its genetic instructions, make the components needed to keep functioning, expand its boundary and distribute a viable biochemical system to its descendants. Its inherited variants would support selectable differences in biochemical behavior. These capabilities are the intended breakthrough, not an achievement established by the supplied study.

Conceptual synthesis: Self-maintenance requires more than placing working biochemical modules inside a membrane. The modules must collectively replace the machinery that wears out or becomes diluted during reproduction. Evolvability adds a further requirement: inherited differences must affect a selectable property across reproducing lineages. Copying DNA alone does not establish either whole-cell reproduction or continuing renewal of the system that copies it.

significance.text: If achieved, this would make at least one self-maintaining, reproducing biochemical organization experimentally constructible from characterized components. The scientific basis is the integration of a replicable information template, machinery that produces cellular components and a compartment whose boundary can be maintained. Such construction would allow researchers to connect molecular mechanisms to the persistence and reproduction of an entire biochemical system.

Reasoned significance: Researchers could alter individual components or subsystem combinations and test which arrangements remain sufficient for reproduction under specified conditions. Heritable selectable variation would also allow experiments on how biochemical organization changes through selection. These are conditional experimental opportunities; constructing one successful cell would not establish that every alternative organization is possible or that the successful inventory is uniquely minimal.

Reasoned limits: An engineered cell could inform origins-of-life research by revealing workable relationships among heredity, metabolism and compartment maintenance. It would not establish how life actually began on Earth, because experimental sufficiency does not demonstrate historical occurrence or chemical plausibility under early-Earth conditions. Useful applications would require additional evidence about reliability, operating conditions and controllability; they would not follow automatically from the first successful construction.

missing_breakthrough.text: The missing capability is coordinated renewal and reproduction of the complete compartmentalized system. The supplied article describes individually reconstituted mechanisms for genetic replication, gene expression, energy regeneration, membrane constituent synthesis and division-related processes. Its integrated system nevertheless depends on supplied machinery and does not achieve physical membrane expansion. The evidence therefore supports specific integration barriers in this system, rather than an unqualified claim about the entire field at a later date.

A central barrier is replacing the biochemical apparatus that carries out the genetic program. The reported partial genome encodes six proteins, while the experiment supplies a PURE cell-free expression system and additional replication proteins. DNA replication must ultimately be coupled to enough component production and machinery renewal to sustain further generations. Otherwise, continued activity can reflect consumption or inheritance of the starting apparatus rather than ongoing self-maintenance.

Membrane synthesis must also become effective compartment growth and division. The study reports lipid production insufficient for detectable membrane growth, leaving a gap between making membrane constituents and expanding a functioning boundary. Engineering synthesis: A reproducing system would additionally need compatible rates of genome replication, component production and boundary expansion, followed by division that leaves descendants with the materials needed to continue. Nutrient and energy supply would have to support these coupled processes within a stated operating environment.

Evolvability must be linked to reproducing compartments. The reported evolutionary-engineering framework uses external phenotype interrogation, liposome sorting, DNA recovery and amplification, followed by re-encapsulation. Connecting inherited variants to selectable biochemical differences in lineages that reproduce while renewing their machinery remains an additional capability beyond this externally mediated workflow.

current_state.text: In “A synthetic cell with integrated DNA self-replication and lipid biosynthesis,” published on 13 February 2026, Ana María Restrepo Sierra and colleagues reported integration of DNA replication, gene expression and phospholipid synthesis inside liposomes. The vesicles contained a partial synthetic genome encoding six proteins, together with supplied PURE cell-free expression machinery, substrates and cofactors. This is a substantial demonstration of coupled biochemical functions within a compartment.

The scope of that achievement is narrower than a self-maintaining, reproducing cell. The genome did not encode the complete expression and maintenance apparatus, and the methods supplied PUREfrex and additional replication proteins. The authors reported that lipid production did not support detectable physical membrane expansion. Complete machinery renewal, coordinated growth and division, and autonomous reproduction over successive generations were not demonstrated.

The study also describes a framework for selecting liposomes with desired properties and recovering their genetic programs. Its cycle involves encapsulation and expression of genome libraries, phenotype interrogation, sorting, DNA recovery and amplification, and renewed encapsulation. This provides a route for externally directed evolutionary engineering; it does not establish self-reproducing cellular lineages or internally sustained evolution of the complete system.

The supplied review assessed full extracted HTML and main-paper PDF texts whose authors, DOI and experimental accounts matched. Figures, movies and raw data were not visually inspected, so the assessment concerns the textual report rather than independent validation of those materials. Supplementary information was available as extracted captions without inspectable figure content in the review, and the peer-review extraction omitted material. An additional eight-page supplementary artifact had no substantive extractable text and could not establish its identity or scientific support. These access limitations restrict assessment; they do not show that the reported results are false.

The supplied material establishes the scope and limitations of this dated demonstration. It contains no freshness search record sufficient to determine whether the broader goal remained unresolved across the field as of 1 November 2026. A field-wide conclusion at that date therefore remains open.

completion_criteria.text: Proposed demonstration: Starting with characterized molecular components and specified supplies of nutrients and energy, compartments should repeatedly grow and divide while internally regenerating the essential machinery needed by subsequent generations. The protocol should distinguish environmental inputs from supplied functional machinery and document what each descendant inherits and produces. These are proposed requirements for this innovation, not established consensus standards.
completion_criteria.label: Compartments repeatedly grow and divide while regenerating essential machinery

completion_criteria.text: Proposed renewal controls: Quantitative measurements should track replacement and turnover of essential machinery, alongside dilution or depletion of the initial inventory. Serial lineage observations and appropriate controls should exclude continued dependence on a finite starting stock as the explanation for apparent reproduction. The number of generations, measurement sensitivity and acceptable carryover would need explicit experimental justification; the supplied evidence does not establish numerical thresholds.
completion_criteria.label: Machinery turnover measurements exclude dependence on finite starting stock

completion_criteria.text: Proposed evolvability demonstration: Traceable inherited variants should change a measurable, selectable biochemical property across reproducing lineages. Controls should distinguish genetic inheritance from differences in starting cargo, transient compartment conditions or external handling. Selection could be imposed experimentally, but the reproduction and machinery renewal being evaluated should occur within the compartments rather than being reconstructed through external PCR and re-encapsulation.
completion_criteria.label: Inherited variants confer selectable biochemical differences across reproducing lineages

completion_criteria.text: Proposed reproducibility and boundaries: Independent preparations, and preferably independent laboratories, should reproduce the integrated behavior using a documented component inventory and protocol. Reports should state nutrient and energy requirements, temperature and medium, external interventions, lineage variability, failure rates and the range of tested inherited changes. Finite demonstrations would establish reproduction and evolvability across those tested conditions, not literal universality, indefinite persistence or a uniquely minimal form of life.
completion_criteria.label: Independent preparations reproduce integrated behavior with reported requirements and limits

related_concepts.text: Roster-based synthesis: BCH-04, “A chemically plausible route from simple feedstocks to evolving heredity,” concerns a possible chemical origin of heredity. BCH-03 concerns construction of a self-maintaining cell from characterized components, which may include complex biological machinery. A successful constructed cell would not establish a plausible origin pathway, and evolving heredity from simple feedstocks would not by itself establish a complete self-maintaining cell.

Roster-based synthesis: BCH-07, “Autonomous heredity in a chemically distinct genetic polymer,” overlaps through replication and inheritance. Its distinguishing objective is heredity implemented in a different genetic chemistry. BCH-03 does not require a chemically distinct polymer, while autonomous polymer heredity alone would not demonstrate renewal, growth and division of an entire cell.

Roster-based synthesis: BCH-01, “General design of enzymes for new chemical reactions,” could provide catalytic components for a constructed cell. BCH-02, “Predict biochemical function from molecular sequence and environment,” could help select and tune those components. BCH-10, “Predict modification-dependent biochemical networks,” could help explain how their interactions change with molecular modifications. These address component design or prediction; BCH-03 requires an integrated system that physically renews and reproduces.

Roster-based synthesis: BCH-09, “Predict and control the biochemical organization of condensates,” concerns spatial organization that might help arrange reactions within a synthetic cell. Condensate control does not itself establish membrane growth, genome inheritance or whole-system renewal. BCH-08, “Resolve the nitrogenase reaction cycle during nitrogen fixation,” addresses the mechanism of a particular catalytic system; it is relevant to potential metabolic capabilities but is not a requirement for the defined-cell concept.

Roster-based synthesis: BCH-05, “Routine, comprehensive single-cell proteoform reading,” and BCH-06, “A multiplexed biochemical flight recorder for living cells,” could offer complementary ways to measure molecular composition and biochemical history during renewal and reproduction. BCH-11, “Routine structural reading of complex glycans,” would be relevant where glycan-containing components are involved. These are analytical capabilities rather than demonstrations of a self-maintaining cell, and none is established here as a prerequisite.

change_log.change: Preserved BCH-03 and its title while expanding the explanation of self-maintenance, reproduction and evolvability.
change_log.reason: The research and review define a coherent hypothetical capability whose identity remains intact despite limitations in supporting claims.

change_log.change: Replaced the unbounded claim that the broader goal remains unresolved with system-specific limitations and an explicit freshness gap.
change_log.reason: The supplied 2026 study supports its own remaining barriers, but the empty freshness record cannot establish field-wide openness as of 1 November 2026.

change_log.change: Distinguished membrane constituent synthesis from comprehensive compartment maintenance and physical growth.
change_log.reason: The study reports phospholipid synthesis but insufficient production for detectable membrane expansion.

change_log.change: Added the publication date, six-protein partial genome, supplied expression machinery and additional replication proteins.
change_log.reason: These details establish what the experiment integrated and why it did not demonstrate complete machinery renewal.

change_log.change: Separated DNA replication and externally mediated evolutionary engineering from whole-cell reproduction and lineage evolvability.
change_log.reason: External sorting, DNA amplification and re-encapsulation do not establish autonomous multigeneration reproduction.

change_log.change: Expanded conditional scientific significance while preserving limits on minimality, historical origins and practical applications.
change_log.reason: Constructing one sufficient biochemical organization would enable controlled experiments without establishing uniqueness, historical occurrence or guaranteed utility.

change_log.change: Developed completion criteria into proposed renewal, inheritance, reproducibility and operating-boundary demonstrations.
change_log.reason: The original criterion is coherent but requires explicit controls and measurements; no numerical or consensus threshold is supplied.

change_log.change: Preserved textual-evidence and supplementary-access limitations and added distinctions across the supplied concept roster.
change_log.reason: Readers need to understand both the scope of the reviewed evidence and how neighboring innovations differ without merging entries.

unresolved_issues: The supplied freshness record does not establish whether later work had achieved the broader capability by 1 November 2026.
A completion protocol still needs justified generation counts, machinery-turnover measurements, carryover limits and selection controls.
The supplied review did not visually inspect figures, movies or raw data; supplementary figure content and portions of the peer-review material remain unassessed.
The identity and scientific content of the eight-page MOESM5 supplementary artifact remain unresolved because it lacked substantive extractable text.
The supplied evidence does not establish which component inventory, environmental conditions or division mechanism would suffice for sustained whole-system renewal and reproduction.
